question: Which of the following pieces is NOT allowed to move backward on a chess board?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Pawn.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pawn is not allowed to move backwards on a chess board.**
 
• Pawns just take small steps, but there are eight of them.
 
• The particular way they move brings to a game of chess structure, strategic content and in the endgame a clear goal. a pawn moves one square straight forward.
 
• It may **not move backwards. pawns take diagonally forwards to a neighbouring square and only that far**.
 
• Because the pawn captures differently from its normal move it can be blocked.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Bishop
 The bishop is interesting because it never moves straight forward, backward or side to side. It cannot hop over other pieces like a knight. The bishop moves only on diagonals.
 
 

 King
 The king can move only one square in any direction, whether it is forward, backward, or sideways. The king also has a special and unique move, known as the castling move. The king can never move into a position that is dangerous for him.
 
 

 Queen
